newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Goldmans drops Stora from recommend list.
newsitem.headline: Goldmans drops Stora from recommend list.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs said on Thursday it had removed Swedish forestry group Stora from its list of recommended stocks two days ago.

"It's true that we have dropped Stora from our recommended list, but we still have it as an 'outperform'," Goldman Sachs forestry analyst Hakan Ostling told Reuters, but declined to give further details.
The 'recommended list' contains strong buy recommendations. Goldman Sachs removed MoDo from its 'priority list' of very strong buy recommendations on August 30.
"We've had a cautious stance on the sector as a whole since late August," Ostling said.
